messages:
lina: Quick heads-up — I'd like to lift the pin on runtime 3.2.0 for a US-west-2 canary tomorrow at 09:00 UTC. Telemetry looks stable overall but we saw intermittent p95 latency spikes (~240ms -> 420ms) during the 03:00–05:00 UTC window yesterday. Need to align on exit criteria + a rollback cordon and heartbeat checks.

sam: can you share which workloads surfaced the spikes? production or internal load test?

lina: mostly internal benchmark sweeps + a small subset of production long-seq requests hitting kvcache warmups. Not widespread but enough to make me cautious.

jorge: important we define a simple heartbeat: p95 < 350ms and error rate < 0.02% over a 15m sliding window for the canary nodes. If either breaches for 3 consecutive 1m buckets we auto-roll back.

maya: sounds good. Also request we gate on tail-sample diffs for long-seq (seq >1024) — if top-5 outliers exceed baseline by 2x we'll abort. We have a quick metric: longseq.outlier_ratio.

sam: agree on metrics. Who will flip the deploybot unpin? We should also add a manual hold window of 30m after unpin in case SEs want to pause.

lina: I can trigger, but want deploybot to run a preflight check. Proposed preflight: health checks OK, p95 baseline within 10% of canary baseline, KV cache hit rate >= 92%.

deploybot: automated preflight will run at T-15m. Preflight checks: 
- nodes reachable
- runtime 3.2.0 image verified
- health endpoints OK
- telemetry stream active

deploybot: to schedule: ```/deploy unpin runtime 3.2.0 --scope canary --region us-west-2 --eta 2026-05-14T09:00Z --preflight 15m --hold 30m```

jorge: +1 on the preflight list. Add an automatic rollback trigger: if p95 > 380ms OR error rate > 0.05% for 5 minutes, rollback immediately and notify #incidents.

maya: I'm adding a lightweight smoke test to run post-unpin that hits a longseq sample set and compares embeddings/equality checks — if quality drift > 0.5% we also rollback.

lina: ack. For runbook: rollback command is `/deploy rollback runtime 3.2.0 --region us-west-2 --reason "canary-telemetry-trigger"`. I'll paste the quick runbook in the runbook doc before T-30m.

sam: I'm adding the release note blurb and will pin it to the canary channel. Also flagging ops to watch the first 30 minutes.

lina: if everyone is +1 I'll schedule the unpin. If no objections by EOD PST I'll proceed. :thumbsup:

maya: +1

jorge: +1

sam: +1

deploybot: scheduled by lina for 2026-05-14T09:00Z. Preflight will run at 2026-05-14T08:45Z. Notifications will go to #eng-releases and #incidents on failures.

lina: thanks — will post the runbook link and the release note before the preflight.
